title: Removing a row the person entered asks on a card, and goes only on the yes

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** under a new Food module, plus a chart that shows your calories per day.

To log something, just tell me what you ate in plain words, for example *"two eggs and toast for breakfast"* or *"a flat white at 3"*. For each entry I'll record:
- what you ate, when, and which meal
- how much
- calories, protein, carbs and fat

If you give me the numbers from a label I'll use those. Otherwise I'll estimate them from standard nutrition data and mark them as estimates. If you don't say when you ate, I'll assume it was just now.

If you have a daily target, such as a calorie or p

I've logged two eggs for today at 16:16, at about **144 kcal**, with 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

The nutrition numbers are my estimate. I based them on standard figures for large eggs cooked without oil or butter, such as boiled or poached. If you fried them or they were a different size, tell me and I'll update the entry. The same goes if you ate them at another time.
